_help: Events move to 'Past events' on their own once they finish. Dates: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm (UK time). 'recurring' events are added automatically for the coming weeks: rule 'weekly' (every given day) or 'monthly' with 'nth' (1–4, or -1 for the last) day of the month. An end time earlier than the start runs past midnight.
